_comment: #3373 — hosts the Browser pane's ⇄ treats as one machine's own loopback, and hosts it does not. Both copies of the predicate are tested against this list: src/services/browser-handoff.ts (isLoopbackHostname, test/routes/browser-handoff.test.ts) and frontend/src/lib/browserHandoff.ts (isLoopbackAddress, frontend/src/lib/browserHandoff.test.ts). Entries are URLs, so each side sees the hostname exactly as URL parses it.
